sentence: This project studies how Group B Streptococcus uses a Type VII secretion system and its toxic substrates to compete with other bacteria in diabetic wounds.
This project builds computational tools that find copy number variation in the malaria parasite Plasmodium falciparum and link it to drug resistance.
This project uses a mouse model of Pompe disease to test therapies that clear stored glycogen and then examines organelles that recycle nutrients.
This project tries to find out how Type I interferon signaling worsens acute lung injury late in viral infection.
This project builds molecules that sense outside signals and produce an output at the level of cellular phenotype.
This project studies lower extremity biomechanics in osteoarthritis a disease with many causes.
This project studies how the immune response changes over time with heart damage in Chagas disease and tests depleting B cells in a murine model.
This project develops a sensitive and quantitative imaging method to diagnose spinal cord injury and predict how the injury will progress.
This project tests how a stem cell therapy relieves pain and lowers inflammation in a rodent model of painful chronic pancreatitis.
This project tries to find out how mast cells and complement contribute to eosinophilic esophagitis.
This project sets up a shared core for single cell transcriptome and epigenome work and bioinformatics on kidney development and disease.
This project builds a drug screening model with stretchable microelectrodes to look for treatments for Alzheimer's Disease.
This project tries to find out how different genes let Staphylococcus epidermidis switch from healthy growth on skin to causing infection.
This project tries to find out which tumor and immune factors affect how children with neuroblastoma respond to immunotherapy.
This project studies how calcineurin signaling helps the fungal pathogen Cryptococcus handle stress and cause disease.
This project tests whether gene variants that lower Tau protein protect people with a Fused in Sarcoma gene mutation from amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
This project studies whether a protein in the blood helps prevent pulmonary arteriovenous malformations in patients with univentricular congenital heart disease.
This project measures how different people respond to a standard mixed meal and to three different diets.
This project studies how nociceptor neurons signal to melanoma cells and pericytes to control how melanoma spreads.
